title: Private VPC go‑live: enablement checklist, release notes coordination, and cross‑team GTM orchestration
creator: Amira Patel
description: Goal: Coordinate a safe, auditable go‑live for Private VPC offering that includes RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integrations. Deliver a roll‑ready enablement package (release notes, admin runbook, tenant checklist, and GTM comms) and align engineering, design, docs, support, sales, and legal on cutover criteria and fallback steps. Avoid overlap with Dedicated capacity launches and ensure private docs are gated behind SSO and partner channels.
acceptance_criteria: Release notes drafted, reviewed by engineering and security, and published to internal release tracker
Admin runbook covering RBAC setup, KMS key provisioning, and audit log retention published to Confluence + handoff to Support
Preflight checklist for customers (network rules, allowed IPs, peering, certs) validated by SRE with a dry run on two pilot tenants
All public-facing docs (Docs site) updated with example IAM policies and migration steps
Sales enablement deck completed with one rehearsal session and recording available
Feature flags and rollout gates validated; automatic rollback plan tested in staging
tasks: Draft release notes summary and detailed breaking changes section
Coordinate security signoff for KMS integration and key lifecycle guidance
Produce customer preflight checklist and sample Terraform network module
Create support triage playbook for common RBAC/KMS failures
Schedule cross‑functional dry run with SRE, Support, and a pilot customer
Run a doc sweep with Docs team for code snippets and CLI examples
Prepare staged announcement email for existing private customers and partner contacts
Publish runtime telemetry dashboard for early ops monitoring during rollout
communication_plan: T-14 days: Internal all‑hands doc + TL;DR email to Eng, SRE, Support, Sales, Legal
T-7 days: Release notes (draft) to external docs review channel + security checklist to legal
T-3 days: Pilot dry run report and operations playbook shared with Support and SRE
Go‑day: Customer status channel open (Slack) staffed by oncall Support, SRE lead, and PM
Go+48h: Post‑launch incident retrospective invite + telegraf of telemetry anomalies
release_notes: Private VPC GA: RBAC, Audit Logs, and Customer‑Managed KMS. Summary: customers can now run Redwood Inference in Private VPC with fine‑grained RBAC, configurable audit log retention to customers' cloud logging sinks, and optional customer‑managed encryption keys (KMS). Known limitations: initial quotas on concurrent dedicated pools, region parity will follow in next sprint. See detailed admin runbook for setup steps and troubleshooting.
support_playbook_summary: Top triage items: IAM misconfigurations, KMS permission denied, audit log delivery timeouts. First responder steps: validate VPC peering, confirm KMS grants, retrieve last 30 audit events via admin console, escalate to SRE if provisioning errors in control plane. Pager runbook link included in links.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Customers misconfigure network tier causing inaccessible endpoints. Mitigation: provide Terraform module and step‑by‑step network checklist; SRE to run network validation for pilot tenants.
Risk: KMS mispermissions lead to failed model loads. Mitigation: include exact IAM policy templates and a dry run utility that validates KMS decrypt calls prior to go‑live.
Risk: Audit log delivery delays create blindspots. Mitigation: default local buffering + alerting on sink delivery SLA breaches; Ops dashboard with alerts for >2 minute delivery lag.
Risk: Documentation gaps cause support tickets. Mitigation: Docs sweep and two internal playbook rehearsals with Support before launch.
